name: 10-zod-v3-parsed-type-thenable
title: Simplify thenable detection in getParsedType
body: The promise check tested `then`/`catch` for truthiness and then again with `typeof`; the `typeof ... === "function"` checks alone are sufficient. Thenables are also checked right after arrays now, since they are a common input for async schemas.

bugs.why: typeof null is "object" and the null check now runs after this line, so getParsedType(null) throws a TypeError reading `then` of null instead of returning "null".
